exclusions.reason: React-specific injection seam accepts a React useFloating hook/UseFloatingReturn. Solid uses the single setup-owned createBaseUIFloating implementation through createAnchorPositioning/useAnchorPositioning; it cannot execute an injected React hook. The positioning API remains exported.

Unwraps React lazy element payloads. Solid render props are native live callback functions, not React elements/lazy payloads, so the React element-unwrapping API is inapplicable. createRenderElement/useRenderElement owns native composition.

nativeTypeMappings.reason: Names the existing @floating-ui/dom Boundary plus Base UI clipping-ancestors spelling. This export accounting does not claim support for React adapter Rect boundaries not implemented by the current native DOM adapter.
Alias of FieldRootContextValue, the existing native accessor/Setter field contract.
